summary.headline: Dermatology network captures $1.18M in annual savings across 12 spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners partnered with Adult & Pediatric Dermatology, PC to centralize purchasing and run two waves of competitive sourcing. The engagement has locked in $630,861 of fully-executed annual savings and a further $549,104 that is either being implemented or awaiting final signatures. Wins span 12 indirect categories—ranging from medical supplies and courier services to janitorial and billing—without disrupting operations thanks to incumbent-friendly negotiations and GPO leverage.

impact.operational_improvements: Centralized vendor contracts across 30+ locations, leveraged two national GPOs for standardized pricing, and instituted SLAs for janitorial and courier partners, reducing administrative burden on clinical staff.

proof_points.statement: Reduced medical-supply costs by 27% ($485K annually) while retaining incumbent McKesson through a dual-GPO strategy.
Negotiated AthenaHealth billing rate down to 1.50%, unlocking $260K per year with no system change.
